learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn to count, make fun groups, and find out what is more or less while playing at the beach!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Let us look around the sunny beach! We can count the big sandcastles, colorful umbrellas, and tiny crabs. Just point your finger at each thing and say the numbers out loud.
Sometimes there are too many shells to count one by one. We can put them in small groups of 2 or 5. Counting groups is very fast and super fun!
Look at the two red buckets. One bucket is full of water, and the other has only a few drops. The full bucket has 'more' water, and the other has 'less'.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Toy Bucket Sorting
fun_activity.instructions: Collect some small toys or buttons at home. Make two groups and tell your parents which group has MORE and which group has LESS!

quick_recap: ⭐ We learned how to carefully count things we see around us.
⭐ We learned how to make small groups to count easily and quickly.
⭐ We can now tell if a group has MORE things or LESS things.
